branch_lifecycle.reason: Keep frozen current profile source while implementing a real engine candidate.
branch_lifecycle.next_review: Independent source audits, then candidate full build/first GPU diagnostics after resource availability.
branch_lifecycle.after_qualification: Integrate source/tests/reports into feature/sycl, update own default, then delete this child branch/worktree.
branch_lifecycle.if_rejected: Preserve compact source decisions and branch-only reports as reachable commits before branch deletion.

verification_scope: Actual real engine SYCL syntax PASS only; host routing candidate already ASan/UBSan checked. No link, GPU, tensor/state, allocation/fit, context262144 or RESTORE qualification.

comparison_protocol.baseline: Frozen existing binary/source and pending current paired diagnostic; no restart of the expired waiter.
comparison_protocol.candidate: Same candidate binary with immutable startup window=0 and window=2 arms.
comparison_protocol.correctness: Small traced first check, actual IDs/slot/job/ne==W/tail/GPU-RAM boundary/nonzero position/PLE/MTP/cancel/fault; full physical262144 consume+RESTORE remains required.
comparison_protocol.speed: Official bench.sh >=32K or64K, thinking enabled, separate diagnostic and clean processes, repeated samples; preserve optimized settings for upstream comparisons. No speed claim from synthetics or nonexclusive intervals.
